description: Groot v2 machine contracts. Every v2 command's --json output is a result envelope whose data matches one of these.

contracts.name: blueprint
contracts.title: groot.json v2 (blueprint)
contracts.description: Portable desired state: apps, capabilities, decisions, environment, verification, context, policy.

contracts.name: manifest-v1
contracts.title: groot.json v1 (manifest)
contracts.description: The v1 manifest — still read by add/doctor; migrated explicitly by `groot migrate`.

contracts.name: lock
contracts.title: groot.lock.json
contracts.description: Exact generator/recipe resolution and Groot-owned artifacts.

contracts.name: project
contracts.title: Project observation
contracts.description: Read-only discovery output (`groot inspect`): facts with provenance, confidence, and freshness.

contracts.name: capability
contracts.title: Capability descriptor
contracts.description: A product or operational result and its recipes.

contracts.name: recipe
contracts.title: Recipe descriptor
contracts.description: Requirements, conflicts, exact versions, env contracts, verification, recovery.

contracts.name: solver-result
contracts.title: Compatibility resolution
contracts.description: Selected recipes in application order, or refusals with alternatives.

contracts.name: plan-intent
contracts.title: Plan intent
contracts.description: What a plan was asked to do (init, adopt, migrate, add-capability, context-sync).

contracts.name: plan
contracts.title: Operation plan
contracts.description: Concrete actions, preconditions, ownership, environment, verification, recovery limits.

contracts.name: journal-record
contracts.title: Journal record
contracts.description: One append-only line of an operation journal.

contracts.name: operation
contracts.title: Operation state
contracts.description: Derived snapshot of an operation (status, steps, resumability).

contracts.name: operation-result
contracts.title: Operation result
contracts.description: Outcome of apply/resume/rollback.

contracts.name: rollback
contracts.title: Rollback preview
contracts.description: Per-step recovery actions, conflicts, and irreversible effects.

contracts.name: evidence
contracts.title: Evidence
contracts.description: One check outcome tied to revision, environment, timing, and artifacts.

contracts.name: verification
contracts.title: Verification report
contracts.description: Structural/build/runtime/product-flow summaries plus evidence.

contracts.name: context
contracts.title: Task context
contracts.description: Concise task-scoped project knowledge (names only, never secret values).

contracts.name: context-sync-change
contracts.title: Context sync change
contracts.description: One managed-instruction file change previewed by `groot context sync`.

contracts.name: task
contracts.title: Agent task
contracts.description: Bounded work for an installed coding agent, with attempts, usage, evidence, review, integration.

contracts.name: review
contracts.title: Task review
contracts.description: Diff summary, acceptance results, ownership violations, verdict.

contracts.name: runner
contracts.title: Runner capabilities
contracts.description: Installed agent discovery: executable, version, auth, supported features.

contracts.name: result
contracts.title: Result envelope
contracts.description: The single stdout document of every v2 command with --json.

contracts.name: error
contracts.title: Error
contracts.description: Structured error with a stable GROOT_E_* identifier and exit code.

contracts.name: blocked-decision
contracts.title: Blocked decision
contracts.description: A choice or prerequisite returned instead of prompting.

contracts.name: event
contracts.title: Progress event
contracts.description: One stderr JSONL progress event (--events).
